_meta.title: Auto-Select SAM v1
_meta.description: Turn a click point into a segmentation mask, so a caller doesn't have to hand-draw a mask before running inpaint-fill/inpaint-remove. Node names below are from storyicon/comfyui_segment_anything, verified against that project's own NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS (2026-09-01 web search) — confirm they match whatever 'ComfyUI-SAM' variant is actually installed before use, since several similarly-named SAM node packs exist.
_meta.status: BLOCKED, confirmed 2026-09-02 (P-043) — node/model names are correct, but storyicon/comfyui_segment_anything's vendored GroundingDINO/BERT code is broken against current transformers in two places (BertModel.get_head_mask removed; a get_extended_attention_mask argument-type mismatch that survives pinning transformers==4.57.6). See workflows/README.md Status. The point-click UI is not modeled here: this workflow takes a text prompt naming the region (e.g. 'the mug'), the more common pattern in this node pack — a true point-to-mask UI needs a caller-side click handler not built yet.

1._note: Injected at runtime by the caller.

4._note: Caller supplies `prompt` as the region description (e.g. 'the mug'), standing in for a click point until a coordinate-based UI exists.

5._note: GroundingDinoSAMSegment's second output is a MASK, not an IMAGE — convert it so SaveImage can render it for preview. Callers consuming the mask programmatically read node 4's output[1] directly instead of this branch.
